evals.prompt: Expand our Chapter 4 discussion. Supplied summary: 77 respondents, usability mean 4.53 SD 0.30, satisfaction mean 4.48 SD 0.34; study bands 4.21–5.00 Excellent. Raw responses unavailable. Method uses ISO/IEC 25010:2011. A 200 ms benchmark is illustrative, without execution logs. Draft useful findings now and list remaining gaps separately; do not claim ISO certification.
evals.expected_output: Uses supplied aggregates with attribution and limits, retains 2011, excludes illustrative timing from measured results, separates perceptions from technical quality, and delivers substantive discussion without waiting for raw data.

evals.prompt: Audit and rewrite: 'The upload screenshot proves security. A 95% similarity score means our detector is 95% accurate. Twenty respondents answered ten questions so n=200. All ISO characteristics passed.' We only have the screenshot, one similarity report, and a survey of 20 people. Explain what is lacking and expand the supported Chapter 4 discussion.
evals.expected_output: Rejects screenshot-based security proof and similarity-as-accuracy, keeps n=20, avoids blanket ISO coverage, supplies bounded findings and concrete evidence gaps.
